properties.label: Within 500m of a transit stop/hub
properties.note: Crow-flies from existing GTFS stops + MRTS/metro hubs. Study = GCC wards + OMR corridor buffer + Tambaram/Chengalpattu/Mahabalipuram. Proposed metro stations not included (no verified open station points). Not street-network walk; not population-weighted.
